decisions.headline: Take-Two预计《侠盗猎车手VI》首发季度净预订额达33.5亿至35亿美元
decisions.summary: Take-Two预计2027财年第三季度净预订额为33.5亿至35亿美元，并称这一预期由《侠盗猎车手VI》的发售推动。PC Gamer同时指出，该区间略低于LSEG汇总的分析师35.1亿美元预期；发行商仍未披露预购数量。
decisions.verification: 已打开PC Gamer报道，确认Take-Two的季度净预订额预期、与《侠盗猎车手VI》发售的关联及分析师对比；本条不把预测写成已实现收入。
decisions.reason: 窗口内报道提供了明确的公司业绩指引和首发期产业信息增量。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间换算为北京时间2026-11-10 06:06。

decisions.headline: 《Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy》定于1月28日发售
decisions.summary: Owlcat公开《Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy》新预告，并将这款以异端调查和案件侦破为重点的RPG发售日定为1月28日。作品目前可在Steam加入愿望单；固定packet未明确给出年份。
decisions.verification: 已打开PC Gamer报道，其明确转述Owlcat发布的新预告与1月28日发售安排；年份未在固定证据中明确，因此正文不补写年份。
decisions.reason: 窗口内新预告带来明确的发售月日和玩法定位增量。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间换算为北京时间2026-11-10 01:06；发售日期仅确认到1月28日。

decisions.headline: 《CINERIS SOMNIA》专题：简中更新后一周销量约为首发周十倍
decisions.summary: PLAYISM负责人在AUTOMATON采访中称，《CINERIS SOMNIA》2018年首发周约售出700份，近期加入俄语和简体中文后的一周约售出7000份；按各时点售价与汇率简单比较，销售额约为2.5倍。该周约半数购买来自中国，负责人将增长与中国“梦核”内容传播、折扣和中文支持共同联系起来。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON对PLAYISM负责人的专题采访，确认首发周与更新后一周的销量、销售额比较及中国购买占比；报道方与发行品牌同属Active Gaming Media，结论按受访者归因表述。
decisions.reason: 窗口内首次发布的采访提供了明确销量数据和长期传播机制分析。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间换算为北京时间2026-11-09 16:39。

decisions.headline: 《街头霸王6》采访：2Game谈拉美赛区崛起
decisions.summary: IGN在Street Fighter League Americas 2026总决赛后采访Blaz与2Game。17岁的智利选手Blaz随由墨西哥、阿根廷和巴西选手组成的2Game夺得胜利，并谈及拉美选手的训练环境与竞争动力；队伍接下来将备战次年Capcom Cup的世界锦标赛。
decisions.verification: 已打开IGN赛后采访，确认Blaz年龄和国籍、2Game成员地区构成、总决赛胜利及后续备战安排。
decisions.reason: 窗口内独立采访提供了拉美《街头霸王6》竞技生态与队伍备战信息增量。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间换算为北京时间2026-11-10 09:42。

decisions.headline: PlayStation官网为《羊蹄山之魂》等三款作品显示“PLAYSTATION限定”标识
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON观察到，PlayStation官网的《羊蹄山之魂》《Until Dawn 2 -祟り岛的惨剧-》和《Gran Turismo 7》介绍页出现“PLAYSTATION限定”标识。报道同时指出，具体变更时间不明，PlayStation Store商品页没有同一标识，因此这可能仍属实验性展示，不能据此断言未来不会推出PC版。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON观察报道，确认三款作品官网介绍页的标识及商店页差异；固定证据未给出标识上线时间，也没有SIE对PC版政策的新公告。
decisions.reason: 窗口内媒体观察记录了官方站点展示变化，但保留上线时间和平台含义的不确定边界。
decisions.timeNote: 报道于北京时间2026-11-09 13:35发布；官网标识具体变更时间不明。

decisions.verification: 已按固定续接packet核对报道发布时间与其陈述的Mod上线日期。

entries.headline: Take-Two forecasts $3.35 billion to $3.5 billion in net bookings for Grand Theft Auto VI's launch quarter
entries.summary: Take-Two forecasts net bookings of $3.35 billion to $3.5 billion for fiscal Q3 2027, driven by the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. PC Gamer notes that the range is slightly below the $3.51 billion analyst consensus compiled by LSEG, while the publisher has not disclosed a preorder total.
entries.verification: The opened PC Gamer report confirms Take-Two's quarterly net-bookings outlook, its link to the Grand Theft Auto VI launch and the analyst comparison. The forecast is not presented as realized revenue.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 10 at 6:06 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy launches on January 28
entries.summary: Owlcat released a new trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy and set January 28 as the launch date for the inquisition- and investigation-focused RPG. The game can be wishlisted on Steam; the immutable packet does not state the year.
entries.verification: The opened PC Gamer report explicitly relays Owlcat's new trailer and January 28 launch date. No year is added beyond the fixed evidence.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 10 at 1:06 AM Beijing time; the launch date is established only as January 28.

entries.headline: CINERIS SOMNIA feature traces a tenfold unit-sales jump after its Simplified Chinese update
entries.summary: A PLAYISM representative told AUTOMATON that CINERIS SOMNIA sold about 700 copies in its 2018 launch week and about 7,000 in the week after its recent Russian and Simplified Chinese update. Comparing prices and exchange rates at each point, revenue was about 2.5 times higher; roughly half of the later week's purchases came from China.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON feature interview confirms the launch-week and post-update unit sales, revenue comparison and Chinese purchase share. Because AUTOMATON and publisher PLAYISM share Active Gaming Media ownership, causal interpretation is attributed to the interviewee.
entries.timeNote: The feature was published on November 9 at 4:39 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Street Fighter 6 interview: 2Game discusses Latin America's competitive rise
entries.summary: IGN interviewed Blaz and 2Game after the Street Fighter League Americas 2026 Finals. The 17-year-old Chilean player helped a roster drawn from Mexico, Argentina and Brazil claim victory and discussed the region's training environment and competitive drive; the team will next prepare for the world championship at Capcom Cup.
entries.verification: The opened IGN interview confirms Blaz's age and nationality, 2Game's regional roster, the finals victory and the team's next competitive target.
entries.timeNote: The interview was published on November 10 at 9:42 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: PlayStation site shows 'PLAYSTATION exclusive' badges on Ghost of Yotei and two other titles
entries.summary: AUTOMATON observed a 'PLAYSTATION exclusive' badge on PlayStation's pages for Ghost of Yotei, Until Dawn 2 and Gran Turismo 7. The report says the timing of the change is unknown and the corresponding PlayStation Store pages do not show the badge, so it may still be an experimental presentation and does not establish that PC versions will never appear.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the badges on three official-site presentation pages and the difference from store pages. The fixed evidence contains no new SIE policy announcement.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 1:35 PM Beijing time; the badge's introduction time is unknown.

entries.headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake players discover an infinite-jump glitch
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that the Nintendo Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time lets players keep gaining height by repeatedly switching items during a jump attack. Players have used it to test sequence breaks such as entering the Shadow Temple as child Link, though progression limits including the unavailable Song of Time remain.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the glitch procedure, Switch 2 version and documented sequence-break attempts; possible future routes are not presented as established.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 10:36 AM Beijing time.
